package.name: lite_description
package.description:
Description package for the Berkeley-Humanoids Lite humanoid. Each variant under lite_description/robots/ (full-body `lite` and `lite_pro`, bimanual `lite_dummy` and `lite_bimanual`, biped `lite_biped` and `lite_biped_debug`) ships xacro as the ROS entry point, including a generated <ros2_control> block, plus a flattened URDF, an MJCF for the training and deployment sim, and meshes. The generator in the `lite_description.workflow` Python package makes every artifact from Onshape CAD, so do not hand-edit them.
The ros2_control hardware plugins (mock_components, mujoco_ros2_control, humanoid_devices_robstride) are referenced by pluginlib string only. They are not build or exec dependencies of this package.
This is an asset-only package. It ships no launch files and no RViz configs, because visualization and bringup are consumer concerns.
